create_nixl_connector_scheduler: create a NixlConnectorScheduler instance with vllm_config, engine_id, and kv_cache_config
build_connector_metadata: build KVConnectorMetadata from scheduler output containing requests needing receive, save, and send
get_sw_clipped_blocks: get sliding-window-clipped block IDs for each KV cache group from full block allocation
get_num_new_matched_tokens: get the number of new tokens matchable from remote KV cache for a request with remote prefill
request_finished: determine whether request blocks should be freed immediately or sent asynchronously on completion
